New Caller ID Rules and Delhi Vehicle Regulations to Start November 1

Starting November 1, new regulations will impact mobile users and vehicle owners in Delhi. The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) has mandated that all telecom companies implement Caller Name Presentation (CNAP), allowing users to see the name of the caller on incoming calls from unknown numbers. Separately, new rules will affect individuals bringing vehicles from outside Delhi into the city, with potential penalties for non-compliance.
